user_saw: New Microsoft Foundry configurations for affected GPT-5 deployments showed limits of 128,000 context tokens and 16,384 output tokens, below the documented capacities.
summary: The fix assigns documented GPT-5 families 400,000 context tokens and 128,000 output tokens in new Microsoft Foundry configurations while preserving existing configured limits.
reasoning: The July 29 blame candidate added native limits for newer GPT-5 families, but its parent and the July 1 snapshot already applied the 128,000/16,384 fallback to the affected models. The offline path history stopped at a missing commit before July 1, so I could not verify when the undersized defaults first shipped or what exposed them.
